senses.gloss: m. pl. (Liburnicus, cmp. Liburnici cuculli, Sm. Ant. s. v. Cucullus) Liburnian mantles.
units: Targ. Is. III, 22 (h. text מטפחות); ed. Wil. a. Bxt. שושיפיא ל׳, taking ל׳ as an adjective: Liburnian clothes; (ed. Lag. ול׳; Var. וּלבוֹרְנְקָיָא, וּלְבוֹרְנַקְיָא; Ar. reads ברנקיא to which cmp. בּוּרְנִי I).
